title: Redeem your 1Password Families benefit
issue: You want the family subscription available with an eligible York 1Password Business account
resolution_html:
1. Sign in to your York 1Password Business account
  2. Open your account menu and select Manage Account
  3. Find the free family account section and select Redeem Now
  4. Choose whether to create a new family account or apply the benefit to an existing account
  5. Use a personal email address for the family account

Follow 1Password’s maintained Families redemption instructions for current screens and eligibility
